comments.body:
@slesaad @sandesh-sp thanks for the thoughtful feedback. In hindsight I should’ve marked this as a wip draft since I wanted to discuss some of the UI notes; sorry for some of the noise and changes here.

> i also have concerns about setting the default mission as deck.gl - is it a little premature?

@slesaad I switched the default back to Leaflet for now. On the fields, I kept most of them in place for now (removed a few mainly to show a pattern we can use, like the shadow fields etc) and only removed layer types from the dropdown along with their associated field filters.

One other thing I also tried is reusing a pattern from veda-ui / veda-config, for example:

1. User pastes a URL in the layer config that includes params (e.g. bidx, rescale, etc.)
2. If something like colormap isn’t specified we fall back to a default (or what’s set in the COG tab for example)
3. If it is specified in the URL that the user pastes, that takes precedence in the final tile request to titiler

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/262b98e5-5819-4a16-81a6-f1c572202f93

This is similar to how veda-ui configs work (config overrides vs defaults) so we get a clear precedence model.

Curious if this is a pattern we want to keep or if you’d prefer a different behavior.
